name: AutoCodeBench-V2
intro: AutoCodeBench-V2于2025年12月4日由腾讯官方发布：它从原始AutoCodeBench数据出发，经顶级闭源模型与沙箱反馈迭代精炼为1,000道更高质量题目。2026年2月17日修正版为998题，覆盖20种编程语言，难度分布为简单136题、中等217题、困难645题。原始论文未定义V2，因此本条目用官方V2说明与评测教程补足论文后的版本流程。
build_method: 原始AutoCodeBench, 顶级闭源模型迭代精炼, V2沙箱反馈, 官方执行验证
drawio_review_note: Evidence-bounded review using arXiv:2508.09101, the official AutoCodeBench homepage news, the official AutoCodeBench-V2 README/tutorial, and tencent/AutoCodeBenchmark data. The paper documents AutoCodeGen and the original 3,920-problem benchmark but predates V2. The official December 4, 2025 announcement states that V2 starts from the original data and is iteratively refined through top proprietary models and sandbox feedback into 1,000 higher-quality problems. The initial file has 136 easy, 218 medium, and 646 hard records; the February 17, 2026 bug-fixed file has 998 records split 136/217/645 across 20 languages. Direct exact-question audits found zero overlap between either V2 file and the original 3,920 questions. The official quick start replaces each output field using a required fenced-code prompt, runs hunyuansandbox/multi-language-sandbox:v2, and verifies with call_sandbox.py at concurrency 32.
build_method_en: Original AutoCodeBench, iterative refinement with top proprietary models, V2 sandbox feedback, official executable verification
intro_en: Tencent officially released AutoCodeBench-V2 on December 4, 2025. Starting from the original AutoCodeBench data, top proprietary models and sandbox feedback iteratively refined it into 1,000 higher-quality problems. The February 17, 2026 bug-fixed snapshot contains 998 problems across 20 programming languages: 136 easy, 217 medium, and 645 hard. Because the original paper predates and does not define V2, this entry uses the official V2 announcement and evaluation tutorial to cover the post-paper version workflow.
